cross_backend_calibration_matrix.interpretation: Rows preserve corpus provenance and distinguish hard-control agreement, threshold-sensitive disagreement, and sparse-only coverage; no row is a universal rank certificate.

finite_sample_uncertainty.reason: Selected and related calibration cases have no specified independent deployment sampling design. Counts and class-specific empirical rates are descriptive only.

hard_controls.classification_count_unit: backend evaluations; use backend-specific class denominators for rates
hard_controls.record_count_scope: Mismatch and unavailable counts are per record and can overlap; agreement requires both backends available and matching the oracle.

interpretation.claim: Saved numerical-rank calibration corpora have explicit aggregate hard-control and threshold-sensitivity statistics.
does_not_establish: a zero-error guarantee outside this finite calibration corpus
OPF physical interpretation or solver KKT conditioning

large_sparse_bmopf_saved_result_screen.interpretation: A saved solver-result point on the 538-bus snapshot provides sparse-only rank evidence with complete point provenance; dense rank remains guarded.

large_sparse_bmopf_screen.interpretation: A guarded 538-bus synthetic coordinate probe provides sparse-only rank and fill evidence; it is not a solver endpoint or physical nullspace certificate.

large_sparse_sparse_only.interpretation: Sparse-only records extend dimensions and constructions while dense SVD is intentionally disabled by guard.

normal_eigen_bmopf_validation.interpretation: Trusted 30/99-bus solver-result points validate backend availability and local rank agreement under scaling policies; larger snapshots are explicitly size-guarded and no physical rank interpretation is inferred.

normal_eigen_calibration.interpretation: The normal-eigen path is an experimental third backend; its squared-spectrum disagreements are retained as tolerance evidence and do not establish a production rank policy.

normal_eigen_policy_persistence.interpretation: Repeated same-point calls and scaling-policy comparisons preserve instability as evidence; no basis-column or policy preference is promoted.

saved_result_bmopf_campaign.interpretation: Saved-result sparse-only screening across 99-bus LN/LG and 538-bus LN/LG endpoints is provenance-complete, with 0 scaling-sensitive and 102 scaling-stable records across SI and PU result representations; dense rank remains guarded.

source.policy: Declared hard controls are counted for false-positive/false-negative statistics; threshold-sensitive controls remain disagreement evidence; dense-unavailable large sparse records are sparse-only coverage.

third_backend_capability.interpretation: Capability evidence is kept separate from dense/sparse calibration results; package discovery does not count as vetted backend evidence.
third_backend_capability.reason: The reviewed internal normal-eigen adapter is available for bounded cross-backend calibration; its squared-spectrum limitation remains explicit.

threshold_sensitive_controls.interpretation: Threshold-sensitive records describe numerical policy disagreement, not detector error.
